name: SkillShelf
tagline: The open library of AI agent skills
description: Browse, scan and install over 1,500 free, open-source skills for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and every agent that speaks SKILL.md. Updated automatically from GitHub.

newsletter.note: Paste a Buttondown / Beehiiv / Mailchimp form action URL to enable the signup form.

tax-and-finance.label: US Taxes & IRS
tax-and-finance.blurb: IRS forms, filing, deductions and small-business tax.
tax-and-finance.intro: AI skills that help Claude and ChatGPT with US taxes: IRS forms like the 1040, Schedule C and 1099s, quarterly estimates, deductions, small-business and LLC tax questions. Draft and check, then confirm with the IRS or a CPA.

legal-tech.label: Legal
legal-tech.blurb: Contracts, court filings, compliance and legal research.
legal-tech.intro: AI skills for US legal work: contract review, NDAs, court filings, small claims, legal research and compliance checklists. Built to help you prepare, not to replace an attorney.

investing.label: Finance & Investing
investing.blurb: Modeling, equity research, wealth management and trading.
investing.intro: AI skills for financial modeling, DCF and LBO models, equity research, portfolio analysis, wealth management and trading research. Use them to speed up analysis, not as investment advice.

food-and-dining.label: Food & Groceries
food-and-dining.blurb: Grocery orders, food delivery, recipes, meal plans and restaurants.
food-and-dining.intro: AI skills for food: order from DoorDash and Instacart, compare Walmart grocery prices, plan meals, manage allergies, cook from recipes and run a restaurant.

marketing-growth.label: Marketing & Growth
marketing-growth.intro: AI skills for marketers: SEO, content, copywriting, ad campaigns, LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram growth, email, CRO and analytics.

product-business.label: Product & Business
product-business.intro: AI skills for product managers and founders: PRDs, roadmaps, user research, go-to-market strategy, pricing and competitor analysis.

hr-careers.label: HR & Careers
hr-careers.blurb: Hiring, people ops, resumes and interviews.
hr-careers.intro: AI skills for HR and careers: recruiting, interviews, job descriptions, performance reviews, compensation, compliance, resumes and people analytics.

health-services.label: Health & Medicine
health-services.blurb: Clinical reference, medical education and care.
health-services.intro: AI skills for clinical reference, medical coding, drug information, HIPAA and FDA documentation, and medical education. Always verify with a licensed clinician.

security-compliance.label: Security & Compliance
security-compliance.intro: AI skills for security audits, code review for vulnerabilities, privacy and compliance standards.

developer-tools.label: Developer Tools
developer-tools.blurb: Code, testing, CI, APIs and the build loop.
developer-tools.intro: AI skills for developers: code review, testing, debugging, CI, APIs, frontend design and shipping faster with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

design-creative.label: Design & Creative
design-creative.blurb: Art, brand, UI and visual generation.
design-creative.intro: AI skills for design: brand guidelines, UI and frontend design, generative art, themes and visual assets.

documents-data.label: Documents & Data
documents-data.blurb: Files, spreadsheets, PDFs and data science.
documents-data.intro: AI skills for documents and data: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files, spreadsheets, notes and data analysis.

workflow.label: Agent Workflow
workflow.blurb: Planning, debugging and disciplined agent habits.
workflow.intro: AI skills that make agents work better: planning, debugging, prompt writing, research and disciplined habits.

ai-ml.label: AI & ML
ai-ml.intro: AI skills for machine learning: Hugging Face models and datasets, training, fine-tuning, evaluation and inference.

communication.label: Communication
communication.intro: AI skills for writing and communication: emails, internal comms, and making AI text sound human.

other.label: Everything Else
other.blurb: Useful skills that defy a label.
other.intro: Useful AI skills that don't fit a single category.

agents.name: Claude.ai
steps: Click "Upload skill" and choose the ZIP.
Start a new chat. Claude loads the skill automatically when it's relevant.

agents.name: Claude Desktop
steps: Click "+" → "Upload a skill" and choose the ZIP.
Start a new conversation. The skill activates when relevant.

agents.name: ChatGPT
steps: Open the skill instructions below and copy them.
In ChatGPT, create a Project (or a custom GPT) and paste them into its instructions.
Upload any files from the skill's references folder as project files.

chat.note: URL of the deployed worker/ (e.g. https://skillshelf-chat.<you>.workers.dev). Empty = the 'Try in Claude' fallback.

seo.note: Paste the content= values from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools (HTML tag method). indexNowKey is public by design.
